narrative: Progress in Oman-Iran talks over the Strait of Hormuz and a disappointing -23k US payrolls print anchor a USD-negative bias for the Tokyo open. EUR/USD closed Friday at 1.1562, supported by a bull steepener regime and the USD's shifting carry profile, while USD/JPY closed at 157.75 with strong put skew (RR -2.20) signaling further downside. Focus shifts to the RBA meeting on Tuesday; AUD/USD closed Friday at 0.7071 and is likely to extend gains as its +71bp OIS carry advantage over the USD remains a primary G10 yield anchor.
